title: gEdit code database
description: A code database file of gEdit (one file in the codes folder of the settings folder): what the G and M codes, cycles and addresses of one control mean, and its templates. A file named like a built-in database is laid over it; a file with a new name extends another database. gEdit itself checks every entry; this description lets another editor point out typing mistakes while you edit the file by hand.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The address of this description, so that an editor can check the file while you type. gEdit does not read it.

dialect.title: Database id
dialect.description: The id of the database, the same as the file name without .json, for example "fanuc-lathe". Profiles name it in their "codes".

version.title: Format version
version.description: The version of the file format; write 1.

extends.title: Extends
extends.description: For a file with a new name: the id of the database it adds to, for example "fanuc-lathe". A file named like a built-in database has none.

remove.title: Codes to remove
remove.description: Codes of the extended database this one does not have, as written there, for example ["G81"].

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: What each address means, by its letter, for example { "X": { "label": "X axis" } }.

additionalProperties.title: Address
additionalProperties.description: One address: its label and an optional description.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the address is, in a few words.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: The codes of the database. In a file laid over another database, an entry for a code it already has changes only what it writes.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: The templates of the database, at most 200. One with the id of a template below replaces it.

flag.title: On or off
flag.description: true, or false (the same as leaving it out).

entry.title: Code
entry.description: One G or M code, address keyword or cycle: what it is called, what it means, its words and what it switches. In a file laid over another code database, an entry for a code that one already has changes only the members it writes.

code.title: Code
code.description: The code as written, for example "G1", "M8", "G54.1" or "CYCL DEF 200". Leading zeros do not matter: G01 is G1.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the code is, in a few words, for example "Linear move". Needed for a code the database below does not have.

description.title: Description
description.description: A sentence or two shown in hover, in your own words.

aliases.title: Other spellings
aliases.description: Other codes that mean the same, for example ["G01"] beside G1 when they differ in more than leading zeros.

group.title: Group
group.description: The code's group, for example "motion", "plane", "feedmode" or "coolant". Codes of one modal group replace each other.

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: true when the code stays active until another code of its group replaces it.

blocks.title: Written in two blocks
blocks.description: 2 for a cycle written in two blocks with the same code (G71 U… R… then G71 P… Q…).

pitchFeed.title: Feed is a thread pitch
pitchFeed.description: true when the feed word of the block is a thread lead, so scaling feeds leaves the block alone.

pitchFeedAmbiguous.title: Maybe a thread
pitchFeedAmbiguous.description: true when the same number is a threading cycle on another kind of machine or in another G-code system, so feed scaling refuses the block.

tappingElsewhere.title: Maybe a tap
tappingElsewhere.description: With "pitchFeedAmbiguous": the other reading is a tap, so speed scaling leaves the block's speed as written.

fNotFeed.title: F is a time
fNotFeed.description: true when the F word of the block is a dwell time, not a feed.

tapping.title: Taps a thread
tapping.description: true for a tapping cycle or mode: its speed and feed are tied by the pitch and are not scaled.

wordsAreData.title: Words are data
wordsAreData.description: true when every word of the block is an argument or a value, not a feed, speed or position (G65, G10).

axisWords.title: Axis words are
axisWords.description: "data" when the axis words are values (G92, G52, G68), "machine" when they are positions in machine coordinates or a reference point (G53, G28).

frame.title: Frame
frame.description: "open" when the code opens a coordinate frame of its own (a tilt, a rotation, a shift), "close" when it closes the open frames of its group.

frameWithoutValues.title: Without values
frameWithoutValues.description: "close" when the code written without any value closes the frames of its group (CYCLE800(), TRANS alone).

frameZeroWords.title: Words whose zero closes
frameZeroWords.description: The angle words that read as no tilt when all of them are zero, for example ["A", "B", "C"].

items.title: Word
items.description: An address or a keyword, for example F.

frameEmptyCloses.title: Sub-block that closes when empty
frameEmptyCloses.description: With "frameZeroWords": the sub-block number whose block closes the frames when it writes none of those words, for example "1" for CYCL DEF 19.1.

frameIdentity.title: Value that means no frame
frameIdentity.description: With "frameZeroWords": the value at which those words read as no frame, for example "1" for a scaling factor. Left out: 0.

flow.title: Program flow
flow.description: What the code does to the order the blocks run in: a "jump", a "label", a "branch", "else", "branch-end", a "loop", "loop-end" or "repeat".

blank.title: Workpiece blank
blank.description: true when the block describes the workpiece blank for the control's graphics (BLK FORM).

positionsRotary.title: Turns the rotary axes
positionsRotary.description: true when the code turns the rotary axes to angles the program does not write (PLANE … TURN, G53.1, CYCLE800).

conflicts.title: Refused while
conflicts.description: The states in which the control refuses this code: tcp, radiusComp, lengthComp, cycle, surfaceSpeed, feedNotPerMinute, frame:<group> or code:<code>; a ! in front means "refused unless", for example ["!frame:frame"].

alone.title: Stands alone
alone.description: true when the code has to stand in a block of its own.

requires.title: Needs one of
requires.description: Addresses or keywords of which the block has to write at least one, for example ["MOVE", "TURN", "STAY"].

items.title: Word
items.description: An address or a keyword, for example F.

usedBy.title: Read by the cycles
usedBy.description: On a cycle that only defines values: the codes of the cycles that read them when they are called, for example ["CYCL DEF 21", "CYCL DEF 22"] for the contour data of cycle 20.

items.title: Word
items.description: An address or a keyword, for example F.

ownWords.title: Its own words
ownWords.description: Addresses that belong to the code when they stand behind it in its block, for example ["F"] for M128 F800.

items.title: Word
items.description: An address or a keyword, for example F.

contour.title: Contour
contour.description: "open" and "close" mark the blocks that describe a contour a later cycle machines; they do not move.

pole.title: Pole
pole.description: "set" on the code whose axis words are the circle centre or pole (CC), "use" on the codes that move around it.

call.title: Calls a program
call.description: true when the code runs another program or section and comes back (G65, CALL LBL).

blockFeed.title: Feed for this block only
blockFeed.description: true when the feed word of the block is the feed of that block only.

shift.title: Shifts the coordinates
shift.description: true when the axis words shift or set the program's coordinate system (G52, G92, TRANS).

shiftZeroIsNone.title: All zero is no shift
shiftZeroIsNone.description: With "shift" (or a data code of the offset group): a block whose every axis value is a written zero sets no shift.

verify.title: Not confirmed
verify.description: true for an entry that is not confirmed yet; it is not shown in hover.

review.title: Review
review.description: "pending" for an entry written from the manuals and not reviewed yet. It changes nothing gEdit shows or computes.

params.title: Words of the code
params.description: The words that belong to the code, in the order a form shows them.

orient.title: Oriented spindle stop
orient.description: true when the code stops the spindle at an angle given by its own value (SPOS=).

machineType.title: Machine type
machineType.description: "mill" or "lathe" where one code database serves both and the code is for one of them only; only the cycle form reads it.

replace.title: Replace whole
replace.description: In a file laid over another code database: true replaces that database's entry whole instead of changing only the members written here.

param.title: Parameter
param.description: One word that belongs to the code, for example Z of G81 or Q201 of CYCL DEF 200: its address, its label and how gEdit reads its value.

address.title: Address
address.description: The address letter or name of the word, for example "Z", "Q201" or "RTP".

label.title: Label
label.description: What the word means, in a few words, for example "Depth".

required.title: Required
required.description: true when the code needs this word in its block.

min.title: Lowest value
min.description: The lowest value the word may have.

max.title: Highest value
max.description: The highest value the word may have.

unit.title: How the value is read
unit.description: Where the value is read differently from its address: "length", "angle", "feedPerMin", "feedPerRev", "dwell", "increment" (always steps of the least increment, with or without a point), "count" (a plain number nothing converts, such as a repeat count) or "feed" (a feed rate in the feed unit in force; the value is read as without a unit, and Scale feed rates knows it is a feed).

decimals.title: Count with decimals
decimals.description: With "unit": "count" only: the count may have decimals, for example a weight or a direction.

position.title: What it is to a shift
position.description: What the value is when the program is shifted: "tool-axis" (a level on the tool axis, such as a reference plane or a depth), "none" (no position: a distance, a feed, a count), "other" (another position: the block is refused) or "mode" (a choice that changes how the other values are read). Left out: not reviewed, and a shift refuses the block.

axis.title: Coordinate of an axis
axis.description: The axis letter when the value is a coordinate of that axis, for example the intermediate point I1 of a CIP arc is a coordinate of X.

programNumber.title: Names a program
programNumber.description: "plain" when the value is a program number (G65 P2000), "packed" when it may also carry a repeat count in front of a four-digit program number (M98 P52000).

inPlane.title: Angle or side in the plane
inPlane.description: "angle" when the value turns what the cycle cuts in the working plane, "side" when it names a side or corner. Rotate and mirror then refuse the cycle.

keepsRotary.title: 0 keeps the rotary axes
keepsRotary.description: On a code that turns the rotary axes: written as 0, this word keeps them where they are (CYCLE800 _DIR).

turnsRotary.title: Turns the rotary axes
turnsRotary.description: On a code that turns the rotary axes: it turns them only in a block that writes this word.

frameZero.title: Value that means no frame
frameZero.description: On a call that opens a frame: "zero" when the call opens no frame while this word is 0, "onesDigit" when it opens none while the ones digit is 0.

frameCloses.title: Value that closes the frames
frameCloses.description: On a call that opens a frame: written exactly as this text, the word closes the frames of the code's group, for example "\"0\"".

signOf.title: Its sign is a direction
signOf.description: "next-move" when the sign of the value is the direction of the move that follows (Okuma G75/G76 L). A mirror then refuses the block.

lengthAlong.title: Length along an axis
lengthAlong.description: The axis letter when the value is a length along that axis (a size, a diameter, a taper), or "plane" for a length in the working plane. Multiplying that axis then refuses the block.

lengthInForce.title: Length stays in force
lengthInForce.description: With "lengthAlong" only: the value stays in force for the following blocks until it is written as 0 (RNDM).

toolOffsetValues.title: Values that write a tool offset
toolOffsetValues.description: On a code that sets an offset (G10 L): the values of this word, as whole numbers written as text, with which the block writes a tool offset instead of a work offset, for example ["1", "10", "11"].

items.title: Value
items.description: A whole number written as text.

twin.title: Same depth the other way
twin.description: The address of the other word of this code that gives the same depth the other way, for example DP and DPR. Both name each other; one is a level on the tool axis, the other a distance.

expandRole.title: Role in the expansion
expandRole.description: What the word is to the expansion of a drilling cycle into plain moves and to the time estimate, for example "depth", "peck" or "feed". Only on a code with "expand".

block.title: Block of a two-block cycle
block.description: On a code with "blocks": 2 only: the block of the cycle the word belongs to, 1 or 2. Left out: both blocks.

sets.title: What the code switches
sets.description: What the code switches on or off for the following blocks, as the modal state reads it, for example { "motion": "feed", "path": "arc", "arcDirection": "cw" }.

feedUnit.title: Feed unit
feedUnit.description: How the following feeds are read.

speedUnit.title: Speed unit
speedUnit.description: "surface" when the word's own value is a cutting speed (SVC=), "rpm" for a spindle speed.

distance.title: Distance mode
distance.description: Absolute or incremental positions from this code on.

units.title: Units
units.description: The program's units from this code on.

plane.title: Working plane
plane.description: The working plane from this code on.

cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.description: "start" or "cancel" a cycle; "define", "call" and "call-modal" for a control that defines a cycle once and calls it later; "call-modal-next" for a word that makes the cycle behind it modal (MCALL).

speedLimit.title: Speed limit
speedLimit.description: true when the S word of this block is a spindle speed limit, not a speed.

diameter.title: Diameter programming
diameter.description: Switches diameter programming on, off, or for absolute positions only.

tcp.title: Tool centre point control
tcp.description: Switches tool centre point control on or off.

planeFromAxisWord.title: Plane from the axis letter
planeFromAxisWord.description: true when a bare axis letter in the block names the tool axis and so the working plane (TOOL CALL 1 Z).

spindle.title: Spindle
spindle.description: Starts or stops the spindle the plain S word drives.

toolSpindle.title: Driven tool spindle
toolSpindle.description: Starts or stops a driven tool's spindle.

radiusComp.title: Radius compensation
radiusComp.description: Switches cutter or nose radius compensation on or off.

lengthComp.title: Length compensation
lengthComp.description: Switches the tool length offset on or off.

exitSpeed.title: Speed after it
exitSpeed.description: "zero" when leaving this code sets the spindle speed to zero.

language.title: Language
language.description: From this code on the control reads its ISO dialect ("iso") or its own language ("native").

path.title: Path
path.description: "arc" for an arc, "cycle" when each block is a whole pass of its own. Left out: a straight line.

arcDirection.title: Arc direction
arcDirection.description: With "path": "arc" only: clockwise ("cw", G2) or counter-clockwise ("ccw", G3), as the control defines it.

compSide.title: Compensation side
compSide.description: With "radiusComp": "on" only: the side the tool keeps to, seen along the direction of travel.

cycleReturn.title: Cycle return level
cycleReturn.description: The level a drilling cycle returns to after each hole: "initial" (G98) or "r-plane" (G99).

expandValue.title: Value
expandValue.description: Where a value comes from: a word of the cycle by its role, { "role": "peck" }, or a field of the form, { "form": "peckRetract" }.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the word that gives the value.

form.title: Form field
form.description: "peckRetract" or "peckClearance", asked in the form and filled in from the machine.

expandStep.title: Step
expandStep.description: One step of one hole, in the order the control runs it, for example { "step": "feed", "to": "depth" }.

to.title: To
to.description: For "rapid" and "feed": the level the move goes to.

mode.title: Pecking
mode.description: For "pecks": "chip-break" (back a little after each peck), "full-retract" (back out after each peck) or "universal" (some chip breaks, then a full retract).

retract.title: Chip break retract
retract.description: For chip-break and universal pecking: how far back after a peck.

back.title: Back
back.description: For full-retract and universal pecking: the level a full retract goes back to. For "lift-off": true for the same move the other way.

reentry.title: Down again to
reentry.description: For full-retract and universal pecking: how far above the last bottom the tool comes back down at rapid.

retractAt.title: Retract at
retractAt.description: For "pecks": a retract moves at "rapid" (the default) or at "feed-out".

at.title: Where
at.description: For "dwell": at the "bottom" or at the "top".

expandSchema.title: Expansion
expandSchema.description: How one drilling cycle runs, as steps: what it is, the steps of one hole, where it returns to and what it leaves in force.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the messages and the statistics call the cycle: "drill", "peck" or "bore".

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The steps of one hole, at least one, and one of them reaches the depth.

returnBy.title: Return level from
returnBy.description: "code": the level the return code in force names (G98/G99); "role": the word with the role return.

relativeDepth.title: Relative depth
relativeDepth.description: How a depth measured from the surface is read: "signed" (surface plus the value) or "into-material" (surface minus the value, without its sign).

leaves.title: What it leaves in force
leaves.description: What the blocks after the cycle find in force, for example { "motion": "before", "feed": "cycle" }.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: "before": the motion in force before the cycle; "cycle": what the cycle left.

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: "before": the feed in force before the cycle; "cycle": what the cycle left.

defaults.title: Default values
defaults.description: For each word with the role default: the value the expansion understands, as text, or a list of values that mean the same, for example { "_AXN": ["0", "3"] }.

additionalProperties.title: Value
additionalProperties.description: A value written as text, or a list of them.

feedOutZero.title: A feed out of 0 means
feedOutZero.description: "feed": a feed-out value of 0 means the moves out run at the in-feed.

expand.title: Expansion into plain moves
expand.description: On a drilling cycle: how it runs, as steps, so it can be written out as plain moves and timed. Either one schema, or { "by": …, "cases": … } when one word picks the way it runs.

by.title: Picked by
by.description: The address of the word with the role variant whose value picks the case.

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: For each value of that word, as written, the schema of the cycle, for example { "0": {…}, "1": {…} }.

dwell.title: How a dwell is written
dwell.description: On a dwell code: the word that takes seconds, the one that takes the least time increments, the one that takes spindle revolutions, or the lines a dwell is written as, with {s} for the seconds.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: The address of the word that takes seconds, for example "X".

increments.title: Least time increments
increments.description: The address of the word that takes the least time increments, for example "P".

revolutions.title: Revolutions
revolutions.description: The address of the word that takes spindle revolutions, for example "S".

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: The lines a dwell is written as, one of them with {s} for the seconds, for example ["CYCL DEF 9.0 DWELL TIME", "CYCL DEF 9.1 DWELL {s}"].

template.title: Template
template.description: A block or a few blocks you insert from the Insert tab: plain NC text with {{field}} places, and a form for the fields.

id.title: Id
id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and -, at most 64, not starting or ending with -, for example "program-start". A template with the id of one in the database below replaces it.

label.title: Label
label.description: The name on the Insert tab, one line of at most 80 characters.

group.title: Group
group.description: The group on the Insert tab, one line of at most 40 characters, for example "Drilling".

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description, one line of at most 500 characters.

toolbar.title: Button
toolbar.description: true puts a button on the Insert tab; the others are in the group's "More…" list.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: true for a body in snippet form (${1:Z-5.}) with no form and no fields.

body.title: Body
body.description: The NC text, with {{id}} for a field, {{N}} at the start of a line for a block number, {{sys.date}}, {{sys.time}}, {{sys.file}} or {{sys.stem}}, and \{{ for a literal {{. At most 200 lines.

params.title: Fields
params.description: The fields of the form, in form order, at most 40.

machineType.title: Machine type
machineType.description: "mill" or "lathe": only programs of that machine type see the template. Left out: every program of the database.

review.title: Review
review.description: "pending" for a template that is not reviewed yet; the Insert tab says so.

templateParam.title: Template field
templateParam.description: One field of the template's form: its id, its label, what it collects and how the value is written.

id.title: Id
id.description: The name the body uses as {{id}}: a lower-case letter or _, then letters, digits or _, at most 32. Not sys, pi or a formula function.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the form shows beside the field, one line of at most 80 characters.

help.title: Help
help.description: A short help text for the field, one line of at most 300 characters.

required.title: Required
required.description: true when the field may not be left empty. Not on a formula.

min.title: Lowest value
min.description: For a number or an integer: the lowest value allowed.

max.title: Highest value
max.description: For a number or an integer: the highest value allowed.

default.title: Default
default.description: The value the form starts with. A number may be written as text, for example "0.5". Not on a formula.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: For a choice: the options, 1 to 50, each with its own value.

prefix.title: Written before
prefix.description: Written in front of the value, usually the address, for example "Z" or "Q201="; at most 16 characters without { or }. An empty optional value drops it.

suffix.title: Written after
suffix.description: Written behind the value; at most 16 characters without { or }.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: For a number or a formula: "as-entered", "min1" (at least a decimal point, 10 becomes 10.) or a fixed count of decimals from 0 to 6.

digits.title: Digits
digits.description: For an integer or a formula: pad with zeros to this many digits, 1 to 9 (42 becomes 0042).

plusSign.title: Plus sign
plusSign.description: true writes + before a positive number.

uppercase.title: Upper case
uppercase.description: For a text: true refuses a value that is not upper case.

comment.title: As a comment
comment.description: For a text: true writes it inside the profile's comment marks.

maxLength.title: Longest text
maxLength.description: For a text: at most this many characters, 1 to 200. A longer value is refused, never cut.

charset.title: Allowed characters
charset.description: For a text: "no-spaces", "letters-digits" (A to Z and 0 to 9 only) or "name" (a letter, then letters and digits).

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: For a number, an integer or a formula: the unit shown beside the field, for example "mm/min"; at most 16 characters. It is only shown, never written.

remember.title: Remember
remember.description: true keeps the last value for the next time. Not on a formula.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: For a formula: the calculation over the other fields, for example "s * z * fz".

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: For a formula: true leaves it out of the form; its value is still written.

templateChoice.title: Choice
templateChoice.description: One option: the label shown and the value written.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the form shows, one line of at most 80 characters.

value.title: Value
value.description: What is written into the program, one line of at most 80 characters without { or }. A number is written as it is.
